description: This file defines an object 'DpadKeys' that provides helper functions to check for DPAD and Enter key actions, facilitating consistent input handling for remote control navigation in an Android TV app.

methods.name: isSelect
methods.description: Checks if the keyCode corresponds to the 'select' action, either DPAD_CENTER or ENTER.

methods.name: isDirectional
methods.description: Checks if the keyCode corresponds to a directional DPAD action (up, down, left, right).
